place_nodes.name: Amsterdam

developmental_reading: The chain is not merely geographic. Every move changes institutional context: manual labor → corporate IT → care work → design/media education → internship office → production school → psychiatric care → integration travel.
Technical competence persists across otherwise discontinuous environments: IT consulting, mediegrafiker study, strong software/design performance and later assistant-teacher-like work in multimedia.
The eventual rejection of the design/office path should therefore be modeled primarily as environment/meaning mismatch rather than academic incapacity.

Kolding is both a constructive node (education/relationship) and the location of the later 2011 rupture; this makes it a major developmental place in the ordinary biography before any later mythic reading is applied.
